primaryUpgrade: Official client-hmr consumes graph/rebuilt frames; same-release gate and changed entry revision must pass, and entry replacement must finish. Native EventSource can reconnect, but original page completion is not observable from the Host.
paneReason: Pane graph excludes hapi-dsh. HHPI source-composer/provider installers are imported once by the primary bundle; refreshing an official pane graph does not itself replace them.
explicitUpdate: SourceNotificationsRuntime.applyUpdate saves checkpoints, activates a waiting worker if any, then calls location.reload. It is bound to explicit Settings buttons, not forced by Host deployment.

oldError.ifPreservedInLiveConversation: First new observer mount reports composer-error once using existing reason only; never reconstructs a prior provider stage.
oldError.ifInputRebuilt: IndexedDB retains File/operation/prepared bytes, not error/name/code. Existing restoration can re-add the retained File and run its original provider operation; only a subsequent real failure supplies a stage.

missingOriginalPageEvidence: original source generation and captured account lifetime
